headline: Xiaomi Launches 18 Pro Phones With Privacy Display, Snapdragon Chip
summary: Xiaomi launched its 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max in China with a privacy display similar to Samsung's Galaxy S26 Ultra and Qualcomm's new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips, according to The Verge and Engadget. Engadget says buyers outside China will have to wait for a global launch.

claims.statement: Xiaomi launched the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max in China.
